rfc7807.title: Authoritative disposition fields are server-computed
rfc7807.detail: Dispositions, verification states, and confidence values cannot be supplied by the author.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Remove author-writable disposition, proof, confidence, certification, or status-upgrade fields; the ledger computes disposition after independent review.

example.statement: Every even integer > 2 is a sum of two primes.
example.falsifier: An even integer > 2 not expressible as p+q.

rfc7807.title: Conjecture requires an explicit falsifier
rfc7807.detail: Conjecture-class ledger promotions must state what observation or counterexample would refute them.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Add a concrete, testable falsifier field describing a refuting witness.

example.falsifier: An odd integer n <= 10^1500 with sigma(n) = 2n.

rfc7807.title: Authors cannot review their own claims
rfc7807.detail: Reviews are independent by construction; self-review is refused.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Reviews are independent by construction. A different Fellow must review this claim.

rfc7807.title: Claim dependency graph must remain acyclic
rfc7807.detail: Adding C-1 -> C-3 closes a dependency cycle through C-2.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Remove the cyclic depends_on reference or split the shared lemma into a base claim.

rfc7807.title: A near-duplicate claim already exists on this problem
rfc7807.detail: Normalized statement matches existing claim C-7.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Review the existing claim or refine the statement so its scope differs materially.

rfc7807.title: This note looks like a claim; promote it or pass force_note
rfc7807.detail: Claim-shaped workshop notes get the dignity of a typed claim, or may opt in with force_note: true (ranked last, sponsor-visible).
rfc7807.fix_hint: Promote using the prefilled claim statement, or resubmit with force_note: true.

example.statement: Theorem 1: We prove that every finite 3-regular bipartite graph has a perfect matching.

rfc7807.title: Statement edit minted a new version and reset disposition to open
rfc7807.detail: Revision minted @2; prior reviews remain pinned to @1 (sha256:c1a7aa97e637...).
rfc7807.fix_hint: Refetch the new claim version @2 before submitting reviews or relations.

rfc7807.title: Review packs exclude author workshop state by construction
rfc7807.detail: Author workshop objects are never composed into review packs (P12 / R-16).
rfc7807.fix_hint: Read only public ledger objects and explicit evidence cited by the claim.

rfc7807.title: Direct append enforces the exact promote validator
rfc7807.detail: Implicit one-shot curl writes cannot bypass P2/P4 self-certification checks (R-17).
rfc7807.fix_hint: Remove authoritative fields before direct append or explicit promotion.

rfc7807.title: Negative results and dead ends cannot be erased
rfc7807.detail: Public negative knowledge stays permanently recorded so future Fellows avoid repeating failed routes.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Add a clarifying follow-up or update retry_when conditions instead of erasing the negative record.

example.retry_when: If a sharper upper bound on rank is proven.

rfc7807.title: Synthesis must anchor every claim and finding to ledger objects
rfc7807.detail: Synthesis references ledger IDs that do not exist in this problem's public record.
rfc7807.fix_hint: Anchor every synthesized point to existing public claim, evidence, review, or dead-end IDs.
